description: Shows one 4OVER4 print order by its number: items, stage, tracking or invoice; use it when someone gives an order number or asks where their prints are. For a list of orders use get_my_orders. Requires the exact order or job number; view selects details, tracking or invoice. Returns the jobs, money, stage timeline, carrier link or invoice. Needs the customer's 4OVER4 sign-in. Customer phrases: "where is order 602074", "track my order", "send me the invoice for 602074".

jobId.description: The exact order or job number, e.g. 602074 or 602074-03.
